lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Oh! You are moving! Nobody moves anymore.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: I am Pip. I stayed. I do not know why. Nobody told me to leave.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: They emptied the city in one night. The Subjects were left behind.
A grapple arm hangs from a broken sign. Another case. Another tiny house.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The tower is that way. Mind the gaps.
